mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment, which may increase quetiapine levels and risk of CNS/cardiac effects; additive CNS depression possible.
action: Monitor electrolytes, renal function, and quetiapine levels; adjust quetiapine dose if renal function declines; assess for increased sedation and cardiac arrhythmias.
